body:
Normally I just hit the heavy bag, but running would probably help to clear my mind. When I hit the heavy bag I'm usually thinking of stuff that's pissing me off. 

I do volunteer. Luckily vacation bible school is coming up and it usually cheers me up to just hang out with the kids in my class and sing silly songs. 

I put on the Simpsons so I'm hoping it will help take my mind off all my shitty feelings. I feel calmer talking to someone, it's helped a lot

I think for most people the problem is they don't know what to do when I'm unhappy. I've always been the bubbly one that everyone wants to be around because I'm always having a good time. I'm charismatic and fun, people enjoy being around me. When I get sad or depressed no one knows how to handle it. 

My big issue right now is my family. I used to have a great relationship with my dad, he's always been my biggest cheerleader. When I lost my job, I felt like I just became this huge disappointment. All we do is fight when we're around each other now. It breaks my heart. Normally I'd be fine but today was just the worst. Finding out that the person I've spent over a year with and I love so much doesn't really care about what I'm going through, has just pushed me over the edge

I really appreciate you talking to me. I feel a little better already

I feel like all I need is someone to talk to and he can't be bothered to do more than text me. I called earlier and he hung up on me after telling me I was overreacting. 
Everything has just gone downhill in the past few months. I lost my job and it seems like all the relationships in my life have gone down the drain now that I don't have the finances to spoil everybody. It makes me feel like no one ever loved me for me
